notes.title: Deathbound Launch Sale
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to announce the launch of our exciting new party-based soulslike game, Deathbound! To celebrate this epic release, we're kicking off a RELEASE CELEBRATION SALE across our entire game portfolio.

Deathbound Release Celebaration Sale

Save 50% on Kao the Kangaroo (2000 re-release) and up to 90% on our other titles! Challenge yourself with the brand-new soulslike experience and embark on a crusade through the forbidden city of Akratya with an exclusive launch discount!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43948138/efb9c6bccc157339d765925edc4274df15541c0e.png

More about Deathbound
Deathbound is a one-of-a-kind party-based soulslike set in a callous world where Faith and Science clash. Dynamically transform between fallen warriors all with their own unique skill sets, combat styles, and rich history. Conquer a brutal reality where Life and Death were never more conflicted.

Grab Deathbound now and dive into a brutal and divided future where Death and Life were never more conflicted...

notes.title: Paws and Claws Winter Sale ❄️
notes.content:
The weather outside may be frightful, but the games in this sale are delightful! 🎄

[previewyoutube=nSgrjALEWbU;full][/previewyoutube]

PAWS & CLAWS WINTER SALE 

It’s that time of year to wish one and all a happy Clawmass from Santa Paws! And what better way to get through the cold winter nights than a bevy of quality games from your friends at Merge, Playtonic, and Tate Multimedia?! 
 
With the likes of Kao The Kangaroo, Lil Gator Game, and Spirt of The North, there are plenty of furry friends to warm up to. For those looking for a more daring slice of adventure, perhaps a winter jaunt to the Bramble King will suit you best!
 
Whatever the weather, mood, and ability, the Paws & Claws Winter sale has something to fill every stocking!
